## What

What changed, in a sentence or two.

## Why

The roadmap item, and why it mattered.

## How it was tested

The checks that ran (`npm test`, `npm run bar`, `npm run build`, probes), what was broken on purpose to prove a test can fail, and what was played in a browser.

## Read first

The one file or commit most worth a reviewer's time.

## Who wrote what

One line. For example: "Claude wrote the code and tests; Ryan reviewed every commit." or "Ryan wrote `migrate()`'s checks; Claude wrote the tests and docs."
